CreateMultiOrder.description_en: Places, renews, or modifies orders for specific products such as the monthly duration package of Wuying Workspace Enterprise Edition
CreateMultiOrder.description_zh: 本接口为无影云电脑企业版按月时长包等部分商品的下单、续费、变配接口

DescribeAICallDetails.description_en: Queries AI model invoke records that meet the specified conditions by using a paged query with paging support
DescribeAICallDetails.description_zh: 分页查询指定条件下的AI模型调用记录

DescribeCreditPackageAgents.description_en: Queries the list of agents and usage summary information for the current user
DescribeCreditPackageAgents.description_zh: 查询当前用户名下的Agent列表及用量汇总信息

DescribeCreditUsageInfo.description_en: Queries the credit usage of users, credit packages, or agents by specified dimension
DescribeCreditUsageInfo.description_zh: 按指定维度查询用户、积分包或Agent的积分使用情况

DescribeDeductionStatistic.description_en: Retrieves statistics on resource deductions and usage under specified conditions
DescribeDeductionStatistic.description_zh: 获取指定条件下的资源抵扣和使用情况统计

DescribeGroups.description_en: Queries the information about deduction groups

DescribeInstances.description_en: Queries sold instances and their quotas and property by page based on the resource type, instance ID, business resource ID, and status
DescribeInstances.description_zh: 按资源类型、实例 ID、业务资源 ID 和状态分页查询售卖实例及其额度和属性

DescribeMultiPrice.description_en: Queries the prices of Wuying Workspace products for order types such as new purchases, renewals, configuration changes, and unsubscriptions
DescribeMultiPrice.description_zh: 查询无影商品的价格，包括新购、续费、变配及退订等订单类型

DescribePackageDeductions.description_en: Queries the deduction details of core-hour packages

ModifyInstanceProperties.description_en: Modifies the attributes of an instance

SetAgentCreditQuota.description_en: Sets the credit quota for specified agents
SetAgentCreditQuota.description_zh: 用于为指定的Agent设置积分使用额度
